original.description: Josh Wardle's original answer list, in play order (puzzle 0 = CIGAR): the array La in the game's JS

nyt.description: Every answer NYT's per-date endpoint returns, from puzzle 0 (Wardle-era dates included) on; one row per date in nyt-archive.csv, with the date each row was fetched

answers.description: answers.csv: union of original-answers.txt and nyt-archive.csv; source is original, nyt-used or both; first_used and nyt_uses come from the NYT archive
